metadata.description: Hyperfocussed & obsessive utilities for the discerning dev goblin

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Roadmaps as a dependency graph: JSON source of truth, mechanical status recompute, projected task lists, Mermaid diagrams, an HTML dashboard and the interview, review and next-task skills that drive it.

plugins.name: goblin-chrome
plugins.description: A mod: goblin-mode's face inside Claude Code. A goblin in the band that reacts to the session, mode pills and hint lines in its voice, a mask over every question, frames by model tier, a day cycle and the project theme's colours. Terminal only.

plugins.name: goblin-util
plugins.description: Two mods: /pain logs friction with Claude Code itself without a turn, context pre-filled; /fleet shows every session on the machine and sends one a line.

plugins.name: roadmap-pane
plugins.description: A mod: /ready opens the roadmap's ready set in a pane with the claims in play and milestone progress, and claims a task after asking who. Ships its own copy of the roadmap CLI; enable the roadmap plugin beside it for the skills.
